| # Object 0x1009 manufacturer hardware version {#object-0x1009-manufacturer-hardware-version-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}                                                                                                                                                                      |                                                                                                                                                                        |
+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

This object contains the device hardware version.

 

  Index           0x1009
  --------------- ---------------------------------------------------
  Name            Manufacturer Hardware version
  Object          VAR
  Data Type       Visible String
  Category        Optional
  Access          const
  PDO Mapping     No
  Value Range     No
  Default Value   Identifier number BR SAP-ID_Number of the device.

 

  -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ![Info](info.png){style="margin:0;width:2.1667in;height:0.6979in;border:none"}   By default, it contains the identifier number BR SAP-ID_Number (Bosch Rexroth) of the device.
  -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
